posts.title: The Oldest Literary Time Machine
posts.description: In June 2018, I wrote about H. G. Wells’s The Sleeper Awakes. Its protagonist, Graham, sleeps for centuries and wakes in a dystopia. In one passage, Wells’s characters mention Edward Bellamy and compare Graham’s predicament to the one in Bellamy’s Looking Backward. Bellamy’s protagonist, Julian West, also wakes after a long sleep, but in a utopia. The following month, I wrote about Bellamy’s novel

posts.title: I used an LLM as a Web Server
posts.description: I used an LLM as a web-server. My motivations for doing so are as unclear to myself as they are to you. This is just something I’d been wanting to experiment with for a while. It’s currently live at llmasaserver.pages.dev. The code is at github.com/anasik/llm-as-a-server.
